# Preferred terms

House terminology for published work and documentation: the word to use, and the one it replaces. Public-safe (it describes the
page, not the person). One entry per line, `avoid | reason | use instead`, read by the term checker in `scripts/` together with the private word list. Add a line when a term is decided; do not reword an entry without saying
so in the commit.

# Domain terms (Adam, 2026-11-08)
hit-rate | house term | success rate, discovery rate
hit rate | house term | success rate, discovery rate
wildcats | house term | wildcat wellbores, exploration wellbores
wildcat well | house term | wildcat wellbore, exploration wellbore
wildcat wells | house term | wildcat wellbores, exploration wellbores
How we know | house label | Basis of analysis

# Names and conventions (house style; CORE.md)
oil equivalents | unit wording | Sm³ o.e. first, boe alongside (1 Sm³ o.e. = 6.29 boe)
Scandinavian design | too general | Norwegian restraint (the house term)

# Not checkable as a phrase: write Sodir (the Norwegian Offshore Directorate) for the body renamed in 2024; the old name only in
# historic citations, quoted licence texts and file paths.

# Plain-word substitutions (derived from CORE "plain words"; Adam to confirm)
utilise | plain words | use
utilize | plain words | use
leverage | plain words (verb) | use, draw on
in order to | plain words | to
prior to | plain words | before
a number of | plain words | several, or the number
going forward | filler | (cut; say when)
best-in-class | hype | (say what it does better)
